settings.subtitle: Three days with the engineers, designers and leaders building what comes next. Twenty sessions, five tracks, no vendor pitches.

settings.items: AI agents in production, Platform engineering, Design systems, Supply chain security, Evaluation, Developer experience, Staff-plus careers, Incident response, Retrieval, Accessibility

settings.headline: A conference for people who ship, run and lead real software.
settings.body: Horizon Summit is practitioner-led and independent. Every talk is selected by a program committee of working engineers and designers, and every speaker builds the thing they are talking about.

settings.headline: Who’s on stage
settings.intro: Researchers, staff engineers, founders and design leads, sharing what worked and what didn’t.

settings.headline: Pick your path
settings.intro: Follow one track for three days, or move between them. Every session page links to the rest of its track.
